text:
rebecca: Heads up — we're seeing a sharp uptick in 502/504s from hosted inference since the canary rollout at 09:12. Multiple customer tickets. @jamal can you triage? sample req ids: req_X7a, req_X7b, req_X7c
jamal: on it. do we have deploy id / flag name?
rebecca: deploy id rollout-2026-03-17-09 / flag: enable-kv-prefetch=true. deploy-bot: canary rollout rollout-2026-03-17-09 started by ci-pipeline at 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z (canary: 10%).
maria: quick glance at route metrics — canary hosts show 10x higher 502 rate, stable looks fine. CPU/mem not spiking. latency on canary nodes higher at tail.
anna: linking dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/xx/canary-compare (look at 5xx and p99 token time) :eyes:
sre-bot: Alert: HOSTED.API.5XX_RATE > 5% for namespace canary (firing)
jamal: can you paste a raw curl that repros? i need headers + request shape.
rebecca: reproducer below (redacted token):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-routing-tag: pref-kv" 
  -d '{"model":"open-13b","input":"hello"}' 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
* Connected to api.redwood.example (10.1.2.3) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"backend timeout","request_id":"req_X7a"}
```
jamal: thanks. the 502 body shows backend timeout. checking upstream logs on canary pods.
devops-bot: kube-events: pod/canary-abc restarted at 2026-03-17T09:14:10Z (OOM:false)
maria: config diff showed: batching.window_ms changed from 10 -> 50 in canary, and enable-kv-prefetch=true added. maybe batching/window interaction causes longer prefix locks and evictions?
jamal: good call. i see kv cache eviction log entries and long lock hold times: 
``
[2026-03-17T09:13:55Z] kvcache: lock_acquire_ms=1200 pool=canary-1 key=prefix-xyz
[2026-03-17T09:13:56Z] inference: request_timeout downstream=60000ms elapsed=61000ms
```
anna: customer-impact note from support: several SV customers reporting "requests hang then 502" — tickets #CS-1123, #CS-1124. billing not broken yet but SLA noise rising.
support: please keep CS posted, we'll update customers on mitigation plan and ETA.
rebecca: suggestion: rollback canary config to previous values, then re-evaluate. we need a coordinated rollback (CS + Product notified).
jamal: agree. i'm preparing rollback steps. locking change set id: cfg-2026-03-17-09-flag.
rebecca: @deploy-bot can you run rollback for rollout-2026-03-17-09 canary?
deploy-bot: Received rollback request. Starting canary rollback...
```
# infra CLI (redwood-infra)
redwood infra rollout rollback --id rollout-2026-03-17-09 --target canary
# or k8s patch (for reference)
kubectl patch deploy hosted-inference-canary -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rollout":"rollback-2026-03-17-09"}}}}}'
```
devops-bot: rollback initiated at 2026-03-17T09:18:02Z
maria: confirming config flip reverted: batching.window_ms=10, enable-kv-prefetch=false on canary hosts.
ajmal: typo — jamal* (small name correction)
jamal: rollback complete on canary at 2026-03-17T09:19:40Z. 5xx rate falling back to baseline. p50/p95 latency back to normal within 2 mins.
rebecca: thank you. support, please message affected customers with rollback done and "we're monitoring". product + infra, we'll schedule a controlled test for the prefetch change (smaller batch + synthetic load) before re-rolling.
support: customer notifications queued.
sre-bot: Alert resolved: HOSTED.API.5XX_RATE back below threshold for canary.
rebecca: follow-ups: 1) postmortem to capture config review gaps, 2) add pre-rollout smoke test that hits kvcache hot keys, 3) docs for rolling back flag toggles (owner: jamal).
maria: assigning action items in the runbook. closing thread after PSR. :white_check_mark:
